description: Yandex Metrica for Next.js App Router and Pages Router: correct SPA pageviews, typed goals, consent gate, CSP helpers and a test mock. Unofficial.
rules: Supports Next.js 15 and 16 with React 18.2 or 19; Next 14 is not supported.

Use exactly one setup: instrumentation-client.ts with register() from '/client' (Next 15.3+), <YandexMetrica /> from '/react' as a sibling of {children} in the root layout, or <YandexMetricaPages /> from '/pages' in _app.tsx.
Pageviews are automatic; never call hit() on route changes.
The counter id defaults to NEXT_PUBLIC_YANDEX_METRICA_ID; nothing is sent in development unless devCounterId or mode: 'on' is set.
Type goal names by augmenting the MetricaGoalRegistry interface of '@boxlab/yandex-metrica-next'.
When Sentry already exports onRouterTransitionStart, combine both with composeRouterTransitionStart.
In tests use installYmMock() and resetMetricaRegistry() from '/testing' and register with mode: 'on'.
